data.name: DownloadPrivacy
data.value: Only confirmation starts network access. Requests reveal the selected geographic areas, never media, filenames or your index. Protomaps / OpenStreetMap (ODbL). Detail: zoom 10–15, Light/Dark, English/Russian where available. Download size and source freshness are unknown before acquisition. Maximum source transfer: 128 MiB per region. Cancel removes unfinished files; verified completed regions remain installed. Regional context is a separate optional approximately 320 km area at zoom 8-10; local detail remains bounded around media.
